title: 月蓝蝶影
detail: FAIRYCORE nocturnal woodland, NOT green/lilac. Moon-blue silk narrow column ankle dress with sweeping black velvet leaf-vein appliques concentrated at neckline and hip; a sculptural high ruffled black lace collar floating over sheer dark navy yoke, sheer midnight-blue detachable long sleeves tied at upper arm. Silver narrow belt and low silver angular lace-up shoes. Strong vertical body, NO giant leaf cape. Adult woman with asymmetric black geometric bob, one side braided tightly above ear, level head and gaze. Frontal composed standing beside dark forest pool, one hand lightly resting on stone balustrade other holding a folded black gauze scarf low; both shoes visible. Blue moonlight and dark tree reflections, restrained mystical botanical atmosphere no magic wings. Reference 2 only lace/velvet botanical column contrasts; new colour, neckline, sleeves, layout.

title: 赤陶孢子
detail: FAIRYCORE warm autumn forest counterpart, no sage/lilac. Original burnt-terracotta crisp silk-taffeta very short balloon cape with sculptural puff shoulders and asymmetric tie-front, opaque butter-ivory fitted long-cuff blouse under it. Chocolate velvet very wide knee-length sculptural culottes with deep reverse pleats, deep brown rib knee socks and antique copper rounded chunky low Mary Jane shoes. Short outer volume versus wide cropped leg, NOT long trousers or another maxi skirt. Adult woman copper-red pixie with clean upward crest and one slender silver pin. Seated upright on warm fallen tree trunk, feet planted apart, head absolutely upright looking level forward, one hand near actual cape fastening other braced on log. Fern glade with pale amber mist and rusty leaves, quiet ecological fairy atmosphere no literal fairy wings. Research2 translucent gathered volume transposed to opaque taffeta bubble cape, tie position re-engineered.

title: 青柠露珠
detail: FAIRYCORE bright citron against rich plum, NO muted sage/ivory all-over maxi dress. Original pale citron tulle handkerchief-hem sleeveless over-tunic with defined opaque bodice and floating high-low panels, embroidered original pearl-white tiny spore dots and fine fern spirals denser near ONE shoulder and lower points, opaque plum silk fitted long sleeve top beneath. Deep plum slender ankle trousers and ivory flat pointed lace-up shoes. Long sheer jagged upper panels over narrow trousers, no flower gown, no thick skirt ruffle. Adult woman ash-brown hair swept into two braided elongated high loops with very short clean fringe. Purposeful upright walking across forest glasshouse stepping stones, head vertical gaze at distant opening, one hand holds small folded ivory cloth other swings naturally. Cold morning dew, broken greenhouse panes and tiny pale wildflowers, related woodland mystery but clearly brighter colour story. Photo2 ONLY tulle embroidery distribution, redesign motif, split hem, layering and trousers.
items: 青柠纱质手帕摆长上衣
参考薄纱与刺绣分布；原创孢点蕨卷，长裙拆成长上衣与细腿裤。
深紫实布从浅纱下显出窄长轮廓，避免再做淡色大蓬裙。
白色平底鞋与高位编环发型
原创建构，保持轻巧与明亮的收集辨识度。

title: 蓝调热身
detail: KOREAN BALLETCORE city-to-studio fashion, vivid baby-blue/bright white/navy, no all-grey pink. Original baby-blue irregular rib fitted knit with broad asymmetric folded boat neckline and extra long sleeves with thumb openings; white opaque cotton tiered wrap MINI skirt over white fitted knit cycling shorts, navy rib knee warmers and glossy navy low double-strap flat Mary Janes with round-square toes (reinterpret photo3, no branding). Adult woman sleek black long high ponytail threaded with one thin white cord and small blunt fringe. Standing upright near rehearsal bench tying narrow side skirt waistband with both hands, head vertical level gaze, legs naturally offset BOTH shoes visible. Industrial Korean rehearsal foyer, blue glazed tiles and warm oak floor with diffuse daylight, not another white barre window scene. Reference2 only folded rib collar and fitted knit, change neckline geometry/sleeves/skirt. Reference3 ONLY banded shoe structure, change toe/strap path and colour. Adult editorial proportions, not school costume.

title: 覆盆子间奏
detail: KOREAN BALLETCORE raspberry-red/blush/cream, rich warm colour counterpart to blue-white companion. Original raspberry soft gathered cotton cropped henley blouse with one broad off-shoulder folded frill (not copied logo), small functional cream tie at front and full sleeves gathered into long narrow cuffs; blush silk-jersey draped wrap skirt to just BELOW knee with a pronounced diagonal petal overlap, cream opaque soft rib socks and raspberry matte low cross-strap flats (new Rockfish interpretation no toe bow). Adult woman short glossy black bowl-pixie with exposed neck, tiny silver barrette. Seated upright on rehearsal landing bench, both feet planted slightly apart, one hand resting on folded cream knit leg warmers on knee other bracing on bench; head fully upright direct steady gaze. Dusty brick studio stairwell with warm peach wall and a dark door, restrained Korean everyday dancewear romance, not traditional white ballet stage. Photo2 ONLY Barnnet gathered feminine cotton/frill and short-long layering, redesign all panel placement, sleeve shape, colour and skirt length. Photo3 only footwear band idea, not exact product.

title: 黄油色散场

Original chocolate fine-rib sleeveless fitted ankle-length flared warm-up jumpsuit with modest square neckline, elongated clean leg line; butter-yellow semiopaque cotton-nylon cropped hooded wrap jacket with cocoon sleeves and gathered drawstring hem, worn open, gathered neck and sleeve adjusters visibly functional. Butter soft socks and chocolate flat double-strap square-round Mary Janes, redesign narrow straps and remove toe bow compared reference2. Adult woman dark auburn slick centre part low braid folded into a flat loop at nape, no head tilt. Purposeful step exiting brick dance studio into late afternoon, one hand carries a butter-yellow folded knit wrap, other hand in jacket pocket, head fully upright gaze forward. Pale ochre wall and charcoal studio door, warm ordinary-city setting with editorial proportions, no theatre costume. Photo2 only shoe opening and twin strap support, original garment design; reference3 Barnnet only loose soft layer over defined base, not copy.
